title: At the Doctor's / Akkuma
bridge: Afan Oromo, hojii sirrii hojjetu kan hin ta’ee. Ingliffa, ‘I have’ + ‘a headache’ dubbatan (I have a headache). Kana malee, ‘hurt’ hojii sirrii hojjetu kan hin ta’ee: ‘My head hurts’. ‘Have’ fi ‘hurt’ hojjetu akkas hin ta’in seenaa tokko irraa kennu malee barbaachisaa ta’u dhaabbata.
rule: A2 irra deebii, hojii sirrii hojjetu akkas ta’u dhaabachuu wajjin: 1) ‘I have’ + macaaf (a headache, a cold, etc.) hojii sirrii hojjetu akkas ta’u dhaabachuu wajjin. 2) ‘My [hojii sirrii] hurts’ dubbatan hojii sirrii tokko irraa hojii sirrii hojjetu akkas ta’u dhaabachuu wajjin. 3) ‘I feel’ + ajjeesa (sick, dizzy, etc.) hojii sirrii hojjetu akkas ta’u dhaabachuu wajjin. Galchiinsa fi dubbachuunsa irra deebii, ‘do/does’ dubbatan (Do you have...?). Akkaataa irra deebii, ‘should’ / ‘shouldn’t’ dubbatan (You should rest).

concept_examples.text: I have a headache and a sore throat.
concept_examples.translation: Hojii sirrii ta’eefi hojii sirrii ta’eetti dhixe.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ˈhɛdeɪk ənd ə sɔːr θroʊt/

concept_examples.text: My stomach hurts after eating.
concept_examples.translation: Dubarti dhiphisu hojii sirrii ta’e.

concept_examples.text: Do you have a fever?
concept_examples.translation: Hojii sirrii ta’aa ta’e?

concept_examples.text: You should drink a lot of water.
concept_examples.translation: Biiqaa hinka dhaabbataa qabna.
concept_examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd drɪŋk ə lɒt əv ˈwɔːtər/

common_error.explanation: ‘Me duele la cabeza’ akkasitti ‘I hurt my head’ dubbachuudha. ‘Hurt’ hojii sirrii hojjetu kan hin ta’ee. ‘Have a headache’ dubbatan hojii sirrii hojjetu akkas ta’u dhaabachuu wajjin. ‘Hurt’ hojii sirrii hojjetu akkas ta’u dhaabachuu wajjin, garuu hojii sirrii hojjetu akkas ta’u dhaabachuu wajjin ‘my head hurts’ dubbatan.

examples.original: I have a cold.
examples.note: ‘Have’ + hojii sirrii hojjetu dubbatan. ‘I am cold’ dubbachuudha; kana malee, ‘I feel cold’ dubbatan.

examples.original: I have a cough and a runny nose.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə kɒf ænd ə ˈrʌni noʊz/
examples.note: Hojii sirrii hojjetu ‘and’ dubbatan akkas ta’u dhaabachuu wajjin. ‘Runny nose’ dubbatan qonnolessaa hojii sirrii hojjetu akkas ta’u dhaabachuu wajjin.

examples.original: I feel dizzy.
examples.note: ‘Feel’ + ajjeesa dubbatan hojii sirrii hojjetu akkas ta’u dhaabachuu wajjin. ‘I feel me’ dubbachuudha.

examples.original: Take this medicine twice a day.
examples.translation: Qofa akka ta’e hinqabne dubarti dhaabbataa qabna.
examples.note: ‘Take’ dubbatan qofa haasa’ee wajjin, ‘drink’ dubbachuudha. ‘Twice a day’ dubbatan dhaabbataa lama hinqabne wajjin.

examples.original: You should rest in bed.
examples.note: Haala dhaabachuu wajjin, ‘should’ + fiilichi dubbatan. ‘Must’ dubbachuudha; kana malee, ‘should’ dubbatan haala dhaabachuu wajjin.

examples.original: I need to make an appointment.
examples.note: ‘Make an appointment’ dubbatan deebii qaba haasa’aa qaba jiru wajjin. ‘Need to’ + fiilichi dubbatan haasa’aa qaba jiru wajjin.

examples.original: My back hurts a lot.
examples.note: ‘A lot’ dubbatan hojii sirrii hojjetu akkas ta’u dhaabachuu wajjin. ‘My back hurts much’ dubbachuudha; kana malee, ‘a’ dubbatan.

examples.original: I have a sharp pain in my chest.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ʃɑːrp peɪn ɪn maɪ tʃɛst/
examples.translation: Dubarti hojii sirrii ta’eefi hojii sirrii ta’e.
examples.note: ‘Sharp’ dubbatan hojii sirrii hojjetu akkas ta’u dhaabachuu wajjin. ‘Dull’ dubbatan hojii sirrii hojjetu akkas ta’u dhaabachuu wajjin. ‘In my + hojii sirrii’ dubbatan hojii sirrii hojjetu akkas ta’u dhaabachuu wajjin.

examples.original: My knee is swollen and red.
examples.note: ‘Is’ + ajjeesa dubbatan hojii sirrii hojjetu akkas ta’u dhaabachuu wajjin. ‘Swollen’ ajjeesa irra deebii.

title: Booking Accommodation / Mana dhihaa qabdu
bridge: Afaan Oromoo keessatti tokko tokko qabduu ‘qabdu’ jedhu kan danda’u dhiisuudha. Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti ‘would like’ fi ‘to book’ hin jiru ‘I would like to book’ jedhu kan danda’u dhiisuudha. Bara dhiisuu fi bara dursuu kan hin qabnu ‘double room’ jedhuu mannaa barbaachisaa irra deebii akkas jedhama ‘habitación doble’. Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti ‘for’ duraa keessatti dhiisuu qabna (‘for two nights’), Afaan Oromoo keessatti garuu ‘two nights’ jedhama.
rule: Mana dhihaa qabdu A2 level keessatti, ‘I would like to book...’ (Mana dhihaa qabdu naa barbaachaa), ‘I’d like to make a reservation’ (Mana dhihaa qabdu naa barbaachaa) akkas akka ta’ee itti fufuuf. Macaafaa keessatti maggaa kee ta’u ‘My name is...’. Guyyaa keessatti ‘on’ (on Monday) fi ‘for’ (for three nights) akkas akka ta’ee itti fufuuf. Mana dhihaa irra deebi’uu ‘Do you have...?’ (Mana dhihaa irra deebi’aa?) ama ‘Is there...?’ (Mana dhihaa irra deebi’aa?) akkas akka ta’ee itti fufuuf. Mana dhihaa irra deebi’uudhaaf ‘single room’ (mana dhihaa tokko), ‘double room’ (mana dhihaa lama), ‘twin room’ (mana dhihaa lama) akkas akka ta’ee itti fufuuf. Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti barbaachisaa fi maggootaa akkas akka ta’ee itti fufuudha. Mana dhihaa irra deebi’uu ‘with’ (fi) akkas akka ta’ee itti fufuuf: ‘with a view’ (fi deebi’aa), ‘with breakfast’ (fi farsa’aa).

concept_examples.text: I would like to book a double room for two nights.
concept_examples.translation: Mana dhihaa lama lamaa guyyaa lamaa qabdu naa barbaachaa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tə bʊk ə ˈdʌbəl ruːm fɔː tuː naɪts/

concept_examples.text: Do you have any rooms available for this weekend?
concept_examples.translation: Mana dhihaa irra deebi’uuf guyyaa walii keessatti irra deebi’aa?
concept_examples.phonetic: /duː juː hæv ˈɛni ruːmz əˈveɪləbəl fɔː ðɪs ˌwiːkˈɛnd/

concept_examples.text: I'd like a room with a sea view, please.
concept_examples.translation: Mana dhihaa hojii keessatti deebi’aa naa barbaachaa, fadhiisa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk ə ruːm wɪð ə siː vjuː pliːz/

concept_examples.text: How much does it cost per night?
concept_examples.translation: Guyyaa tokko qabyaa hojjetaa?
concept_examples.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ɪt kɒst pɜː naɪt/

common_error.wrong: I want reserve a room for two nights.
common_error.correct: I would like to reserve a room for two nights.
common_error.correct_alt: I'd like to book a room for two nights.
common_error.explanation: Afaan Oromoo keessatti ‘naa barbaachaa’ jedhuu ‘want’ jedhuu hin jiru, Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti garuu ‘want’ jedhuu dhumaasaa ta’ee jiraatu. ‘Would like’ (naa barbaachaa) jedhuu dhumaasaa ta’ee jiraatu. ‘Would like’ jedhamuu ‘to’ fi amantii qabduu akkas ‘I would like to reserve’ jedhuu danda’u dhiisuu qabna. ‘I want reserve’ (hin jiru ‘to’) jedhuu akkas hin taane. ‘Book’ (qabdu) jedhuu mana dhihaa keessatti dhumaasaa ta’ee jiraatu.

examples.original: Do you have a single room available?
examples.phonetic: /duː juː hæv ə ˈsɪŋɡəl ruːm əˈveɪləbəl/
examples.note: ‘Do you have...?’ jedhuu irra deebi’uuf barbaachisuu qabna. ‘Available’ jedhuu maggootaa irra deebii akkas jedhama.

examples.original: Is there a room for tonight?
examples.translation: Mana dhihaa guyyaa yii keessatti irra deebi’aa?
examples.note: ‘Is there...?’ jedhuu irra deebi’uuf barbaachisuu qabna.

examples.original: Are there any free rooms on Friday?
examples.phonetic: /ɑːr ðeər ˈɛni friː ruːmz ɒn ˈfraɪdeɪ/
examples.translation: Mana dhihaa irra deebi’uudhaaf guyyaa bilbilaa keessatti irra deebi’aa?
examples.note: Bara dhiisuu keessatti ‘Are there any...?’ jedhuu akkas akka ta’ee itti fufuudha. ‘On’ jedhuu guyyaa bilbilaa keessatti dhiisuu qabna.

examples.original: I'm sorry, we're fully booked.
examples.translation: Dhiiggoo, mana dhihaa irra deebi’uudhaaf hin jiru.
examples.note: ‘Fully booked’ jedhuu mana dhihaa irra deebi’uudhaaf hin jiruu akkas jedhama.

examples.original: I'd like to book a double room for three nights.
examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə bʊk ə ˈdʌbəl ruːm fɔː θriː naɪts/
examples.translation: Mana dhihaa lama lamaa guyyaa saddaan qabdu naa barbaachaa.
examples.note: ‘I’d like’ (‘would like’ jedhuu qallii) jedhuu dhumaasaa ta’ee jiraatu.

examples.original: Can I reserve a room with a balcony?
examples.phonetic: /kæn aɪ rɪˈzɜːv ə ruːm wɪð ə ˈbælkəni/
examples.translation: Mana dhihaa hojii keessatti qabdu naa barbaachaa?
examples.note: ‘Can I...?’ jedhuu barbaachisuu qabna. ‘With’ jedhuu barbaachisaa keessatti dhiisuu qabna.

examples.original: My name is Ana García. I have a reservation.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ neɪm ɪz ˈɑːnə ɡɑːrˈsiːə aɪ hæv ə ˌrezəˈveɪʃən/
examples.translation: Maggaasa Anaa Garcii qaba. Mana dhihaa qabduu kan danda’u.
examples.note: Mana dhihaa keessatti maggaa kee fi mana dhihaa qabduu kan danda’u jedhuu akkas akka ta’ee itti fufuudha. ‘Reservation’ jedhuu Afaan Oromoo ‘qabdu’ jedhuu irra deebi’aa jiraatu.

examples.original: I need to cancel my reservation.
examples.translation: Mana dhihaa qabduu kee gufachu naa barbaachaa.
examples.note: ‘Need to’ fi amantii qabduu ‘naa barbaachaa’ jedhuu akkas akka ta’ee itti fufuudha. ‘Cancel’ jedhuu Afaan Oromoo ‘gufachu’ jedhuu irra deebi’aa jiraatu.

examples.original: How much is it per night?
examples.note: ‘How much’ jedhuu hojjetaa irra deebi’uuf barbaachisuu qabna. ‘Per night’ jedhuu ‘guyyaa tokko’ jedhuu akkas jedhama.

examples.original: Does the price include breakfast?
examples.note: Guyyaa sadii keessatti ‘Does’ jedhuu akkas akka ta’ee itti fufuudha. ‘Include’ jedhuu Afaan Oromoo ‘keessatti jiru’ jedhuu irra deebi’aa jiraatu.

examples.original: Is Wi-Fi free?
examples.note: Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti ‘is’ jedhuu barbaachisaa irra deebii akkas jedhama. ‘Free’ jedhuu ‘qajeelfama’ ama ‘hin qabnu’ jedhuu akkas jedhama.

examples.original: What time is check-out?
examples.note: ‘Check-out’ jedhuu guyyaa fuulaa, ‘check-in’ jedhuu guyyaa dhaabbataa akkas akka ta’ee itti fufuudha.

title: At the Bank or Exchange Office / Bankiin yookiin mana xixinnan
bridge: Afan Oromo, kan biraa haasa’uu dhiisuu keessatti ‘kana malee hin jiru’ yookiin ‘haa fayyadami’ jedhanii akkasumas ingilizii ‘I would like...’ yookiin ‘Can I...?’ jedhanii erga jiru. Akkasumas, ingilizii ‘can’ fi ‘would’ jedhanii fiilichi walqixxummaa tokko tokkoo hojjetaa ta’ee ‘to’ akkasumas ‘some’ yookiin ‘any’ jedhanii walitti deebii kennamanii jiraatanii erga itti dhaga’ama. Ingilizii laggeen fi du’aa biraa qindeessan akkasumas du’aa biraa qindeessuun laggeessa jiraatanii erga itti dhaga’ama.
rule: Bankiin yookiin mana xixinnan deebi’uu keessatti ‘I would like’ (kana malee hin jiru) fi ‘to’ + fiilichi walqixxummaa tokko tokkoo hojjetaa ta’ee ‘I would like to exchange dollars’ (kana malee hin jiru du’aa biraa qindeessu). ‘Can I...?’ jedhanii akkasumas deebi’uu keessatti ‘Can I open an account?’ (haa fayyadami bankiin malee hin jiru?) jedhanii erga jiru. Mana xixinnii kennuu keessatti ‘What is the exchange rate?’ (mana xixinnii kennuu waaqayyo?) jedhanii erga jiru. ‘Some’ (kan biraa) fi ‘any’ (kan biraa hin jiru) jedhanii walitti deebii kennamanii jiraatanii erga itti dhaga’ama. Akkasumas, laggeen fi du’aa biraa qindeessan akkasumas du’aa biraa qindeessuun laggeessa jiraatanii erga itti dhaga’ama.

concept_examples.text: I would like to exchange some dollars.
concept_examples.translation: Kana malee hin jiru du’aa biraa qindeessu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tuː ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ sʌm ˈdɑːlərz/

concept_examples.text: What is the exchange rate?
concept_examples.translation: Mana xixinnii kennuu waaqayyo?

concept_examples.text: Can I open a bank account?
concept_examples.translation: Haa fayyadami bankiin malee hin jiru?

concept_examples.text: I need to withdraw some money.
concept_examples.translation: Du’a hin jiru qindeessu malee hin jiru.

common_error.correct_alt: I would like to change money.
common_error.explanation: Afan Oromo, ‘kana malee hin jiru du’aa biraa qindeessu’ jedhanii ‘to’ akkasumas fiilichi walqixxummaa tokko tokkoo hojjetaa ta’ee ‘I want to change...’ yookiin ‘I would like to change...’ jedhanii erga jiru. Akkasumas, ‘to’ jedhanii ‘want’ jedhanii hin kennine ‘I want change...’ jedhanii akkasumas itti fufi kennamuu danda’a. ‘To’ jedhanii fiilichi walqixxummaa tokko tokkoo hojjetaa ta’ee erga itti dhaga’ama.

examples.original: I would like to exchange euros for pounds.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tuː ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ˈjʊərəʊz fɔː paʊndz/
examples.translation: Kana malee hin jiru yuroo liibraa qindeessu.
examples.note: ‘For’ jedhanii du’aa biraa qindeessuuf kennamu.

examples.original: What is the rate for dollars?
examples.translation: Mana xixinnii kennuu du’aa biraa waaqayyo?
examples.note: Mana xixinnii kennuu keessatti ‘rate’ jedhanii erga jiru.

examples.original: Can I have some small bills?
examples.translation: Haa fayyadami du’aa kessummaa hin jiru?
examples.note: ‘Small bills’ jedhanii du’aa kessummaa hin jiru.

examples.original: Is there a commission?
examples.note: Ingilizii, ‘Is there...?’ jedhanii singular keessatti erga jiru.

examples.original: I want to deposit this check into my account.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒnt tuː dɪˈpɒzɪt ðɪs tʃek ˈɪntuː maɪ əˈkaʊnt/
examples.translation: Chequee kana bankiitti deebi’u malee hin jiru.
examples.note: ‘Into my account’ jedhanii du’aa biraa qindeessuuf kennamu.

examples.original: Can you withdraw money from my account?
examples.phonetic: /kæn juː wɪðˈdrɔː ˈmʌni frɒm maɪ əˈkaʊnt/
examples.translation: Haa fayyadami bankiin keessan du’a qindeessu?
examples.note: ‘Withdraw from’ jedhanii preposition sirrii ta’e.

examples.original: How much is the service fee?
examples.note: Qorophii hojii kennuu keessatti ‘How much’ jedhanii erga jiru.

examples.original: My account number is 12345.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ əˈkaʊnt ˈnʌmbər ɪz wʌn tuː θriː fɔː faɪv/
examples.note: Ingilizii, laggeen sirrii ta’e yookiin laggeen tokko tokkoo hojjetaa ta’e.

examples.original: I need to transfer money online.
examples.translation: Du’a hin jiru qindeessu internettitti malee hin jiru.
examples.note: ‘Online’ jedhanii internettitti deebi’uu keessatti erga jiru.

examples.original: This is a currency exchange form.
examples.translation: Mana xixinnii du’aa biraa qindeessuun foormii kana.
examples.note: ‘Currency’ jedhanii du’aa biraa qindeessuun erga jiru.

title: Job Interview Basics / Maalaalaa Baafata Duubatti
bridge: Ingliffaatti baafata duubatti, galmeessan dhaabbataa isaanii akkasuma qorattoota isaanii malee qoodanu. Afaan Oromoofi haran hin eeggannu; ‘you’ malees hin jiru. Kanarraa, ‘present simple’ akka ta’ee adabbi waliiwwanitti dhufnu argachuu wajjin haasa’aa, ‘past simple’ garuu baafata duubatti waliiwwanitti dhufnu argachuu wajjin haasa’u. ‘Do/does’ galmeessaniif kennuuf dhaabachuu qaba.”
rule: Warri hojjetaa duubatu, ‘I am’ (ani kan) jechuuf jechuudha. Warri akka ta’e hojjeta duubatu, ‘I work as...’ (ani ... hojjeta) jechuuf jechuudha. Warri baafata duubatti waliiwwanitti dhufnu akka ta’e hojjeta duubatu, ‘I worked at...’ (ani ... hojjeta) jechuuf jechuudha. Galmeessan dhaabbataa isaanii ‘What do you do?’ (warri ta’e hojjetaa?), ‘Why do you want this job?’ (phayadhuun yoo ta’e barbaaduu?), ‘What are your strengths?’ (haala bilisa ta’aa keessan sii qaba?). Ingliffaatti garuu warri hojjetaa hin qabnu.”

concept_examples.text: I am a student.
concept_examples.translation: Ani mana barumsa.

concept_examples.text: I have experience in customer service.
concept_examples.translation: Baafata macaafii qilleensaa keessatti waliiwwan si’a ta’e.

concept_examples.text: I worked at a restaurant.
concept_examples.translation: Mana baafata dukan keessatti hojjeta.

concept_examples.text: Why do you want this job?
concept_examples.translation: Phayadhuun yoo ta’e barbaaduu?

common_error.explanation: Afaan Oromootti ‘sanaa 25 irraa jira’ jechuudhaan tokko, Ingliffaatti garuu sanaa ‘to be’ (kan) jechuun barbaadaa, ‘have’ (qaba) hin barbaanu. Fakkeenyaa miti ifatti hin kenninu.

examples.original: My name is Ana.
examples.note: ‘My name is’ jechuun warri hojjetaa duubatu barbaachisaa qaba.

examples.original: I am from Mexico.
examples.note: ‘From’ jechuun warri akka ta’e jiraatu duubatu barbaada.

examples.original: I live in Madrid.
examples.note: ‘Present simple’ jechuun warri haqimmilkennaa ta’e duubatu barbaada.

examples.original: I can speak English.
examples.note: ‘Can’ jechuun adabbi waliiwwanitti dhufnu barbaada, ‘sé’ jechuun hin barbaanu.

examples.original: I am good at computers.
examples.note: ‘Good at’ + isin gosa jechuun adabbi waliiwwanitti dhufnu barbaada.

examples.original: I know how to use Excel.
examples.translation: Excel akka ta’e itti fayyadamu bilisa ta’e.
examples.note: ‘Know how to’ + isin gosa jechuun adabbi waliiwwanitti dhufnu barbaada.

examples.original: What are your strengths?
examples.translation: Haala bilisa ta’aa keessan sii qaba?
examples.note: Galmeessaa dhaabbataa isaaniiti, ‘I am...’ jechuu jechuu danda’a.

examples.original: Why do you want this job?
examples.note: ‘Because’ jechuun warri phayadhuun duubatu barbaada.

examples.original: I work well in a team.
examples.note: Haala bilisa ta’aa keessan adabbiiwwanitti dhufnu barbaada.

title: At the post office / Posta qabxii keessatti
bridge: Ingliffii keessumaa, posta qabxii keessatti macaafaa fi baqalaa ta'ee hojjetan qabnu hafan qabnu godhaman, 'I need to' ama 'I'd like to' jedhan ibsuudha. Afaan Oromoo keessumaa, 'dhaqaa' ama 'dhaabbata' jedhama. Ingliffii keessumaa, 'send' jedha 'to' jedhan hojjetan qaba, Afaan Oromoo keessumaa 'dhaabbata' jedha 'isa' jedhan hojjetan qaba. Fidhii walitti himtuu kan danda'an godhaman, 'How much does it cost?' jedhan, Afaan Oromoo keessumaa 'Qabya isaaniif kan danda'a?' jedhama.
rule: Ingliffii A2 sirrii keessumaa, posta qabxii fi hojjetii ta'ee hojjetan qabnu hafan qabnu godhaman, haala malee qorata: 1) 'I need to + verbo' (dhaqaa + infinitivii) hafan qabnu godhaman, fakkeenya 'I need to send this package.' 2) 'I'd like to + verbo' (dhaabbata + infinitivii) baqalaa ta'ee hojjetan qabnu godhaman, fakkeenya 'I'd like to buy some stamps.' 3) 'How much is/are...?' fi 'How much does it cost?' qabya ta'ee walitti himtan qabnu godhaman, fakkeenya 'How much is the shipping?' 4) 'to' jedha 'send' fi 'mail' jedhan hojjetan qaba godhaman, fakkeenya 'Send it to my friend.' 5) 'where' fi 'when' jedhan posta qabxii fi hojjetii ta'ee walitti himtan qabnu godhaman, fakkeenya 'Where can I pick up my package?' Ingliffii keessumaa, ajjeefama sirrii qabduudha (registered mail), Afaan Oromoo keessumaa ajjeefama sirrii qabduu danda'a (posta qabuu ta'ee ajjeefama).

concept_examples.text: I need to send a letter to Spain.
concept_examples.translation: Dhaqaa isaanii Espaniyaa dhaabbatan argachuuf.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tə sɛnd ə ˈlɛtər tə speɪn/

concept_examples.text: How much does this package cost to ship?
concept_examples.translation: Qabya kan danda'uun pakajii kana dhaabbatan argachuuf?
concept_examples.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ðɪs ˈpækɪdʒ kɒst tə ʃɪp/

concept_examples.text: I'd like to buy some stamps, please.
concept_examples.translation: Dhaabbata baqalaa ta'ee walitti dhufu, fadii keessan.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə baɪ sʌm stæmps pliːz/

concept_examples.text: Where can I track my package?
concept_examples.translation: Pakajii keessan argachuuf kan danda'u malii?

common_error.correct: How much does the shipping cost?
common_error.explanation: Qorichaa kana malee, Afaan Oromoo keessumaa 'Qabya isaaniif kan danda'a?' jedhama, Ingliffii keessumaa 'cost' jedhan walitti himtuu 'does' jedhan fi amantiqii sirrii qabduudha. 'Costs' jedha 'does' jedhan hojjetan qabu danda'a. Haraa malee, 'is' jedha 'cost' jedhan deebii danda'a.

levels.label: Basic needs at the post office

examples.original: I need to buy some stamps.

title: Renting a Flat / Mana qulqulluun isa ani dubartiin qulqullu
bridge: Afaan Oromoo keessatti, mana qulqulluun isa ani dubartiin qulqullu jechuu dhiisuu ‘qulqullu’ ani ‘dubartiin qulqullu’ jedhama. Mana qulqulluun isa ani dubartiin qulqullu jechuu dhiisuu ‘qulqullu’ ani ‘dubartiin qulqullu’ jedhama. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, ‘rent’ jedhamtu verb ani noun qabduudha. ‘Available’ ani ‘for rent’ jedhamtu mana qulqulluun isa ani dubartiin qulqullu jechuu dhiisuu ‘available’ ani ‘for rent’ jedhama. Preposition keessatti dhiibbaa ta’uufi: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti ‘rent an apartment’ jedhama (preposition hin qabne), Afaan Oromoo keessatti garuu ‘qulqullu mana qulqullu’ jedhama. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, wantoota fayyamama ‘is for rent’ ani ‘is available’ jedhamtu godhaa ta’e, Afaan Oromoo keessatti garuu ‘qulqullu’ ani ‘dubartiin qulqullu’ jedhama.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii A2 level keessatti mana qulqulluun isa ani dubartiin qulqullu jechuu dhiisuu haa ta’u malee: (1) Verb ‘to rent’ (qulqullu) ani hojii keessaniif: rent / rents / renting / rented. (2) Preposition ‘for’ noun ‘rent’ kana hin qabne ‘for rent’ (qulqullu). (3) Adjective ‘available’ (dubartiin qulqullu) mana qulqulluun isa ani dubartiin qulqullu jechuu dhiisuu ‘available’ jedhama. (4) Vocabulary: ‘apartment’ (mana qulqullu/ dubartiin qulqullu), ‘flat’ (mana qulqullu, Afaan Ingilizii Britainii keessatti hin jiru), ‘landlord’ (qulqullu/dubartiin qulqullu), ‘tenant’ (qulqullu/dubartiin qulqullu), ‘deposit’ (fianza/depósito), ‘rent’ (qulqullu biraa), ‘lease’ (qulqullu sirrii). (5) Akkasumas, ‘How much is the rent?’ (¿Cuánto es el alquiler?) ani ‘Is it furnished?’ (¿Está amueblado?) jechuuf godhaa ta’u.

title: Making small talk at a party / Daandiiwwan gammaduu kan qabachuun
bridge: Afaan Ispaaniitti, daandiiwwan gammaduu deebii akkan jedhu ‘¿Qué tal?’ ammas ‘¿Cómo estás?’ dhufu, ‘estar’ kan dubbatan irra deebifachuu wajjin tokko tokkoo malee isaan irra deebisu. Afaan Ingiliffaa, ‘How are you?’ dubbachuufis, ‘How's it going?’ ammas ‘What's up?’ dubbachuu dha. Ta’u malee, ‘I am agree’ jedhu ‘estoy de acuerdo’ irra deebisu dhaa isaan hin qabne; ‘I agree’ jedha. ‘How are you?’ irra deebifachuu akkasuma ‘I'm good, thanks’ jechuudhaan dhaa isaan irra deebisu, haa ta’u malee akkamuma hin kan qabne, Afaan Ispaanii irra deebifachuuwwan akkas hin qabne.
rule: Daandiiwwan gammaduu kan qabachuuf, ‘Hey, how's it going?’ ammas ‘What's up?’ (dubbachuu: ‘Not much, you?’) dubbachuu qabna. Isinitti dubbachuu akkasuma ‘I'm [name], nice to meet you’ jedha. Dubbii tokko ilaalchuuf, ‘Would you like something to drink?’ (haala dhaabbataa) ammas ‘Do you want a drink?’ (dhaabbataa) dubbachuu qabna. Haala malees, ‘I like...’ / ‘I don’t like...’ jedha. Haala isinitti qajeelfama ‘agree’ (hija ‘be agree’) dubbachuu qabna: ‘I agree with you’. ‘How are you?’ irra deebifachuu akkasuma ‘I'm good’, ‘I'm fine’, ‘Pretty good’ jechuudhaan dhaa isaan irra deebisu. Daandiiwwan gammaduu kan qabachuuf, ‘It was nice talking to you’ ammas ‘See you later’ jedha.

Gaffii kunis akkasuma qajeelfama ‘agree’ dubbachuu ‘do’ dubbachuu danda’a: ‘I don't agree’, ‘Do you agree?’.

title: Complaining and Apologizing / Gadaa fi walqixaa
bridge: Afaan Espanii, 'lo siento' ama 'perdón' hunduu jechuu akkas jedhu, garuu afaan Ingiliffaa irra deebii akkam jedhamu godhaa ta'u: 'I'm sorry' kan biraatiif ama kan aarsaa ta'e jechuuf godha, 'excuse me' garragaa guddisu ama walqixaa xixinnoo ta'e jechuuf godha. Afaan Ingiliffaan gadaa kennu, aadaa sadarkaa 'can't' ama 'won't' kan argachuu fi kan biraa ta'e jechuuf godha, afaan Espanii 'no puedo' ama 'no quiere' jechuudhaan godha. Fakkeenyaa godhataa fi 'to' dubbii 'sorry' irra deebi'ee akkas jechuu dandeessu.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffaa gadaa kennu, 'I can't + verbo' (maqaa qabdu) ama 'This is + adjetivo' (kuni kun godha) godhaa ta'u. Walqixaa kennu, 'I'm sorry (for) + gerundio' ama 'I apologize for + sustantivo' godhaa ta'u. 'Sorry' dubbi 'for' irra deebi'ee akkas jechuu dandeessu (I'm sorry for being late). Tokkummaa akkas ta'e, 'I apologize' biraa jira. Walqixaa qabuu akkas jechuu dandeessu: 'It's okay', 'No problem', ama 'That's fine'. 'I'm sorry' seenaa kennu godhaa ta'u ('excuse me' godhaa ta'u).

title: Describing your hometown / Mana dhaabbataa keessa kennu
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, mana dhaabbataa keessa kennu, amarcissa ‘to be’ deebii keenya jiraatu (big, small, quiet) haguu ‘there is/there are’ kana malee barbaachisaa qabuuf jechuuf argama. Afaan Isbaanichaa keessatti, ‘es grande’ kana ‘hay un parque’ jedhama; garuu afaan Ingilizii keessatti, ‘there is’ hin laalchuu ‘there are’ laalchuu malees. Hegaaddis, seena qabduwwan wajjin tokkoo barbaachisaa qabuuf danda’a: guyyaa tokkoo haguu deebii keessatti, ‘My city is big’ jechuun danda’a. Nama qorata afaan Isbaanichaa qabduwwan ‘there is/are’ ummaa hin kennamne haguu barbaachisaa qabuu nuti kennuu danda’a, ‘the city big’ jechuun bakka ‘the big city’ jechuu danda’a.
rule:
Mana dhaabbataa keessa kennu afaan Ingilizii A2 keessatti, hojiidaan walitti walitti barbaachisaa qabuuf danda’a:

1. **Guyyaa + deebii ‘to be’ (am/is/are) + barbaachisaa qabuu**: Barbaachisaa umrii kennu. Fakkeenya: ‘My town is small.’ (Mana dhaabbataa kee hin jiru).
   - Kana pronomeessa: I am, you are, he/she/it is, we are, they are.
   - Barbaachisaa qabuu nuti kennuu danda’a: ‘a big city’, hin laalchuu ‘a city big’. 

2. **There is / There are**: Mana dhaabbataa keessatti sirrii tokko jiru jechuuf.
   - There is + nuti hin laalchuu/sirrii tokko: ‘There is a park.’ (Sirrii tokko jira).
   - There are + nuti laalchuu: ‘There are two schools.’ (Baroota lamaa jira).
   - Kana bira: There isn’t / There aren’t: ‘There isn’t a cinema.’ (Siinimaa hin jiru).
   - Kana galata: Is there...? Are there...? (Sirrii tokko jiraa?).

3. **Preposishani barbaachisaa qabuu**: Sirrii tokko barbaachisaa qabuuf jechuuf.
   - ‘in the center’ (keessummaa), ‘on the corner’ (gurguddaa keessatti), ‘near’ (du’aa keessatti), ‘next to’ (du’aa keessatti).

4. **Deebii hojii**: ‘You can see’, ‘you can find’, ‘there is’ kana malee ‘sirrii tokko jira’ jechuuf danda’a.

5. **Conectorii**: ‘and’ hojii tokko tokkoo kennuu danda’a haguu ‘but’ hojii tokko tokkoo hin kennuu danda’a: ‘My town is small but beautiful.’ (Mana dhaabbataa kee hin jiru garuu aduun).

A2 keessatti, seena qabuwwan seenaa haguu hojii tokko tokkoo kennuuf danda’a. ‘There is’ nuti laalchuu ‘there are’ jechuu malee – ‘there is many shops’ jedhu hin dandeessu.

examples.translation: Sirrii tokko haguu sirrii tokko jira.
examples.note: Sirrii lamaa kennuuf, ‘there is’ sirrii tokkoo barbaachisaa qabuuf danda’a, garuu nuti laalchuu ‘there are’ ummaa kennuuf danda’a.

examples.original: There are many restaurants in the main square.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑː ˈmeni ˈrestərɒnts ɪn ðə meɪn skweər/
examples.note: ‘Many’ nuti laalchuu barbaachisaa qabuuf danda’a, ‘muchos restaurantes’ jechuun afaan Isbaanichaa keessatti.

examples.original: Is there a supermarket near here?
examples.note: Galataa keessatti, ‘Is there...?’ jechuuf danda’a.

examples.original: There aren't any museums in my town.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːnt ˈeni mjuːˈziːəmz ɪn maɪ taʊn/
examples.translation: Sirrii tokko mana dhaabbataa keessatti hin jiru.
examples.note: ‘Aren’t any’ nuti laalchuu hin jiru jechuuf danda’a; ‘there isn’t’ sirrii tokkoo hin jiru jechuuf danda’a.

examples.original: I love my city because it's beautiful.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv maɪ ˈsɪti bɪkəz ɪts ˈbjuːtɪfʊl/
examples.note: ‘Because’ hojii kennuuf danda’a, ‘porque’ jechuun afaan Isbaanichaa keessatti.

examples.original: You should visit the old castle.
examples.note: ‘Should’ hojii kennuuf danda’a; ‘deberías’ jechuun afaan Isbaanichaa keessatti.

examples.original: It's a great place to live.
examples.note: ‘A great place’ sirrii tokko aduun jira jechuu danda’a; ‘live’ (jiraatu) ‘in’ hin kennamneef danda’a.

title: Talking About Hobbies / Afaan Ingilizii keessatti hoba nama hubachiisaan godhamu
bridge: Afaan Oromo keessatti, hoba nama hubachiisuu keessatti ‘gustar’ kana ‘encantar’ jedhan ibsuudhaan dhaabachuu qabna. Ingilizii keessatti, ‘like’ jedhan ibsuu barbaachisaa ta’ee ‘I like + -ing’ kana ‘I like + to + verbo’ jedhan akkas godha. Akkasumas, Ingilizii keessatti guyyaa lamaa ‘on Mondays’ jedhan akkas godha; Afaan Oromo keessatti garuu ‘los lunes’ jedhan akkas godha. Ingilizii keessatti ‘do’ jedhan ibsuu ‘What do you do in your free time?’ jedhan akkas godha; Afaan Oromo keessatti garuu ‘¿Qué haces en tu tiempo libre?’ jedhan akkas godha.
rule: Ingilizii keessatti hoba nama hubachiisuu (qoree A2): ‘like’, ‘love’, ‘enjoy’ kana ‘prefer’ jedhan ibsuu barbaachisaa ta’ee dhugaa kana -ing irra deebi’aa (ex. ‘I like music’, ‘I love playing soccer’). ‘Be interested in’ + dhugaa kana -ing irra deebi’aa (ex. ‘I'm interested in photography’). Galaanii keessatti, ‘What do you like doing?’ kana ‘What do you do in your free time?’ jedhan akkas godha. Guyyaa lamaa ‘always’, ‘usually’, ‘sometimes’, ‘never’ jedhan akkas godha. ‘In’ (in my free time), ‘on’ (on weekends, on Mondays) kana ‘at’ (at home, at the weekend – Afaan Ingilizii Britaanichaa) jedhan akkas godha. Haala dhiisee: ‘do’ jedhan ibsuu ‘like’ keessatti afoo wanti hinqabne (kan ‘I like’ jedhu, ‘I do like’ hinjedhu; haala dhiisuu akkasuma hinqabne).

concept_examples.text: I like listening to music.
concept_examples.translation: Inni musikii dhaga’uu qaba.

concept_examples.text: She loves playing tennis.
concept_examples.translation: Isa tennisiin amantiisuu qaba.

concept_examples.text: What do you do in your free time?
concept_examples.translation: Hubachaa keessanitti haa faayida?
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɒt duː juː duː ɪn jɔː friː taɪm/

concept_examples.text: I usually go hiking on weekends.
concept_examples.translation: Guyyaa lamaa walqixxummaa keessanitti jalaa gala.

common_error.explanation: Erraa kana kanaa Afaan Oromo keessatti ‘me gusta jugar’ jedhan akkas godhu; barumsa anis ‘like’ jedhan keessatti akkas godhamuufis. Ingilizii keessatti garuu, ‘like’, ‘love’, ‘enjoy’ jedhan keessatti -ing kana ‘to’ irra deebi’aa (‘to’ hin kanne garuu hin deebine). Haala dhiisuu ‘like’ jedhan keessatti -ing irra deebi’aa: ‘I like playing’. ‘I like to play’ jedhan akkasuma godha; garuu kanatti dhihaa.

examples.original: I love reading books.
examples.note: ‘Love’ + -ing jedhan akkas godhaaf haala dhiisuu amantii dhihaa godhu. Afaan Oromo keessatti ‘encantar’ jedhan akkas godha.

examples.original: She enjoys painting.
examples.note: ‘Enjoy’ + -ing jedhan akkas godha. ‘Enjoy to paint’ hin jedhu.

examples.original: I don't like cooking.
examples.note: Dhiisuu ‘don't’ + like + -ing jedhan akkas godha. Afaan Oromo keessatti ‘no me gusta’ jedhan akkas godha.

levels.label: Asking Others About Hobbies
levels.translation: Namni tokko tokko hoba nama hubachiisuu galaanii

examples.original: What do you like doing?
examples.note: Kun galaanii hoba nama hubachiisuu godhamuun barbaachisaa ta’ee. Afaan Oromo keessatti ‘¿Qué te gusta hacer?’ jedhan akkas godha.

examples.original: Do you play any sports?
examples.note: ‘Play’ jedhan ibsuu riyoodhaa qormaatiin (play football, play tennis) godha. Afaan Oromo keessatti ‘jugar’ jedhan akkas godha.

examples.original: How often do you go to the cinema?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ ˈɒfən duː juː ɡəʊ tə ðə ˈsɪnəmə/
examples.note: Afaan Oromo keessatti ‘ir al cine’ jedhan akkas godha; Ingilizii keessatti garuu ‘go to + lugar’ jedhan akkas godha.

examples.original: I often watch TV in the evening.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɒfən wɒtʃ ˌtiːˈviː ɪn ðə ˈiːvnɪŋ/
examples.translation: Guyyaa lamaa walii qabyaa teelee bilbilaa.
examples.note: Guyyaa lamaa (often, usually, always) jedhan akkas godha. Afaan Oromo keessatti ‘a menudo’ jedhan akkas godha.

examples.original: I prefer playing video games to reading.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ prɪˈfɜː ˈpleɪɪŋ ˈvɪdiəʊ ɡeɪmz tə ˈriːdɪŋ/
examples.translation: Inni ga’ee amantii qaba inni kitaaba chaqaa amantii hin qaba.
examples.note: Amantii tokko ak kas tokko godhuu ‘prefer A to B’ jedhan akkas godha; lamaa tokko tokko -ing irra deebi’aa. Afaan Oromo keessatti ‘prefiero X a Y’ jedhan akkas godha.

examples.original: On Sundays, I usually go for a walk.
examples.phonetic: /ɒn ˈsʌndeɪz aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ɡəʊ fər ə wɔːk/
examples.translation: Guyyaa lamaa dilbata, jalaa walqixxummaa gala.
examples.note: ‘On’ jedhan ibsuu guyyaa lamaa qormaataa godha. Afaan Oromo keessatti ‘los domingos’ jedhan akkas godha.
